title: Chicken chorioallantoic membrane as a reliable model to evaluate osteosarcoma
author: Manjunathan, Ragunathan
materials: Human osteoblast derived SaOS2 cells were grown in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 1 % penicilline/streptomycine, (SIGMA, Aldrich, USA) at 37 °C in a humidified 5 % CO2 incubator until it get full confluent [17].

All the experiments were performed in triplicate (n = 3) unless otherwise specified. Data are presented as mean ± SEM and were analysed by Descriptive analysis for ± SEM and One-Way ANOVA analysis of Holm-Sidak Test for appropriate using SigmaPlot 12. P values of p = < 0.001, p = 0.001, p = 0.010 and p = 0.005 were considered for statistical significance.

steps.title: Culture SaOS2 osteoblast cells
steps.instruction: Grow human SaOS2 osteoblast cells in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum and 1 % penicillin/streptomycin (Sigma, Aldrich, USA) at 37 °C in a humidified 5 % CO₂ incubator until the culture reaches full confluence.

steps.title: Prepare cell suspension for CAM implantation
steps.instruction: Detach confluent SaOS2 cells with trypsin/EDTA (Medox, India), centrifuge the suspension at 1200 rpm for 5 min, wash the pellet twice with DMEM lacking FBS, and resuspend in DMEM alone to obtain three concentrations: 30 × 10⁶, 60 × 10⁶, and 120 × 10⁶ cells in 20 µL each.

substeps.instruction: Wash pellet twice with DMEM without FBS.
Resuspend in DMEM alone to achieve 30, 60, and 120 lakh cells per 20 µL.

steps.title: Assess angiogenic ability on CAM
steps.instruction: Implant the prepared cell suspensions onto the chicken chorioallantoic membrane (CAM) and evaluate angiogenesis by (i) direct visual scoring and scanning microscopic analysis, (ii) measuring vessel sprouting and growth with Angioquant software for each cell density, (iii) analyzing invasiveness via histological staining, and (iv) confirming expression of angiogenic factors at different progression stages by molecular and protein‑level expression analysis.

substeps.instruction: Score angiogenic ability by direct visualization and scanning microscopy.
Measure vessel sprouting and growth using Angioquant software for each cell concentration.
Confirm angiogenic factor involvement by molecular and protein expression analyses at differential stages.

steps.title: Perform statistical analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct all experiments in triplicate (n = 3). Present data as mean ± SEM, perform descriptive analysis and One‑Way ANOVA with Holm‑Sidak post‑test using SigmaPlot 12, and consider p‑values of <0.001, =0.001, =0.010, and =0.005 as statistically significant.
